description: Every production release after the cutover: the fleet stays declared and built from source; no class may be created, deleted, renamed or transferred; no data resource deleted or replaced.

rollback.why: EXECUTOR_TELEMETRY holds the telemetry settings and the build version, the pinned upstream commit: it changes only when a release moves that pin or the telemetry destination, so between two ordinary releases it is equal and no force is expected. When it does change, Cloudflare refuses to roll a Worker back across it without force; forced, the earlier version comes back with the value it ran with, the one that matches its code, and serving does not depend on it.
